notes.title: English Version Updated
notes.notes:
Thanks for the help from "Woosk" and the steam group "Visual novel, JRPG, Anime", we now have a better English version with many issue fixed.

[b]Version: 3256239[/b], to make sure the game updated to the latest version by Steam client, please check the 'local file' tab from property window.

Known Issues and Tips:

[quote] The resolution of this game is 1600x900, not 1280x720.
Some laptop or tablet might have issues because of the windowed mode.

Enter the Display Setting from the Desktop by right click, change the scale mode to 100%.

In Windowed mode, press alt+0 could zoom in or zoom out the image. Let us know if there are other issues.
[/quote]

[quote]The original game window size is 1600x900, and we have noticed that it may have display problem on Laptop with a smaller screen.

We have added a new hot key, ALT+0, to change the size of game window to 1280x720.

Press ALT+0 one more time and the size will change back to 1600x900.

If you still have problems please feel free to leave a comment,
[/quote]

Thank you for purchasing and playing Lingering Fragrance!
